comments.body:
Closing. #2308 replaces this PR and #2300, #2301, #2302, #2303, #2304 and #2305.

These seven PRs fix one bug: provider plugins that drop the caller's `context.Context`. Each PR fixes it in one file, with the same explanation and the same test written again. A single search of the codebase finds every case. Seven PRs means seven reviews, seven CI runs and seven merges for one change. That cost falls on the maintainers.

I did not merge these commits. I wrote one fix that covers all the providers, and that one commit replaces all seven PRs.

Please do not send more PRs like this. If you find a defect, search the full codebase for it and fix every case in one PR. Use AI tools if you want, but read the output, find the full scope of the problem, and send one complete change. I will close any future set of small PRs for the same defect without review.
